blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Panoramic City Tour through the historical center of Bogota, also called "La Candelaria". We will visit the Gold Museum, where we will see nearly 34,000 pre-Hispanic gold pieces and more than 25,000 pre-Columbian objects. Afterward, we will visit the Casa de la Moneda and Donation Botero where art pieces of the master Fernando Botero, are exhibited. Botero is a Colombian artist internationally recognized in different artistic techniques such as painting, drawing, and sculpture. The tour will end with a panoramic tour of the Plaza de Bolívar (The Prime Cathedral, The House of Nariño, The Liévano Palace, and The Palace of Justice). In the afternoon, return to the hotel.

Duration: 4 hours

Includes: Entry ticket to the Gold Museum, Casa De La Moneda, and Botero Donation, guide service in English and private transportation, and local medical assistance card.

blocks.text: Wednesday or Friday: Zipaquirá and Guatavita

provenance.rationale: Use the verified weekdays and two excursion stops from the Day 3 heading for this short route label.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the Hotel. A circuit through Guatavita and Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá will begin at the agreed time: A complete circuit through the so-called “Sabana de Bogotá”. The tour will start from Bogotá to the town of Zipaquirá, where one of the main tourist sites in Colombia is located, the majestic Salt Cathedral built 180 meters deep from a salt mine. Later we will depart to the Guatavita Lagoon, known historically and worldwide for the legend of "El Dorado". In the afternoon, return to the Hotel. (Includes Lunch)

Duration: 10 hours,

Includes: Guatavita Lagoon Entrance, Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral, guide service, Lunch and private transportation, Local medical assistance card

* Note: for single accommodation in Zipaquirá and Guatavita tour is shared and includes: Guatavita and Salt Cathedral: Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time you will start the tour with a visit to the Guatavita Lagoon, sacred site for the Muisca culture and place that inspires the Legend of El Dorado. Afterwards, you will cross the savannah and arrive at the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquira, the first wonder of Colombia. With its impressive architecture completely carved in salt, this subway temple will give you an amazing experience by visiting the virtual reality theater, the water mirror and the largest underground cross in the world. Duration: 10 hours. This day includes: round trip transportation from meeting points, bilingual coordinator (Spanish - English), entrance fee (Guatavita and Salt Cathedral), local guide in Spanish at Guatavita Lagoon, free time to visit the salt cathedral (2 hours), free time for lunch (not included) or visit to the village (7 languages) *We recommend to bring your own headphones, medical assistance card.
